title: Pick–Nav–Reach · goal-conditioned RL
summary: Fetch picks a supplied object, carries it through an unseen maze and holds it at the goal. The current best system completes 80% of unseen-maze tasks. Imitation of a planner does the work; the next phase gives SAC/TD3 a job the teacher does badly: carrying without the object slipping.

headline.detail: Object slides out during carry in ~13% of cases

headline.detail: Imitation-only 362/460 vs SAC fine-tuned 374/460 across dev, hold-out and course

plan.step: Clean up repository and build a fast evaluator

Step 1: carry-motion rules do not reduce drops (turn limits, slip slowdown)
